verdict.rationale: BILL documents custom approval policies, tolerance rules, and 2-way/3-way matching (docs-7, docs-10, docs-20, docs-31) plus real-time webhook event notifications (docs-3, docs-16) that could feed an audit trail, but there is no explicit documentation of an immutable edit/approval history log designed to survive external audit scrutiny. missing for 10: explicit audit-log/history feature documentation, retention guarantees, and any independent/third-party confirmation that audit trails hold up under external audit.
